interface.title: fielddash – Diagnóstico de Resíduos – Itaqui-Bacanga (example project)
interface.field: Social science / environmental field surveys (household waste-management survey, São Luís, Brazil)
interface.stage_of_work: Monitoring data as it is collected and exploring it afterwards: field survey responses from Epicollect5 or local JSON, before deeper analysis elsewhere
interface.what_it_is_for: A dashboard built from the survey's form schema that summarises responses, maps where they were collected, cross-tabulates questions, applies filters to every view, and exports the filtered table.

data.note: The bundled anonymized example (examples/waste/project.yaml) loaded on its own: 18 responses, 3 collectors, 50 columns, collected 10/12/2024–19/06/2025. There was no login and no upload. The live Epicollect5 source was not used.

features.name: Global filter sidebar with add-a-question filters
features.general: Restrict a dataset by a date range and by category values of chosen fields, add filters on any other field as needed, and have every summary, map, chart and export use the same subset, with a caption saying what is applied
features.specific: Sidebar Filters: Collection date range picker, fixed multiselects (Bairro, Idade, Gênero, Renda), and 'Add filter' to add a multiselect for any question. The header shows 'Filters: Bairro, Gênero (5 of 18 responses)'
steps: Pick a date range in the Collection date calendar
Choose one or more values in a field's multiselect (e.g. Bairro = Vila Bacanga)
Optionally add another question via Add filter and choose its values
Read the 'N of M responses' caption and move between pages; all views use the subset
Clear a filter (⊗) or remove an added filter to widen again
serves_tasks: Filter by a demographic or location attribute and see the summary, map and charts update
Add a filter on any other question
Restrict to a collection time window
Remove filters to return to the full dataset
Export the filtered table for further analysis

features.name: Cross-tab question explorer with type-driven charts
features.general: Show the distribution of every question, with the chart chosen from the question's type in the form schema: categorical answers as bars (100% stacked bars within each group when split by a second question), numeric answers as a histogram with mean/median (box plots per group when split). A text search narrows the questions and a toggle hides free-text ones
features.specific: Questions page: 'Cross with' select, 'Search question' box, 'Hide open-ended' toggle, and Questionnaire / Endereço section tabs, with one chart card per question plus an answered-count or mean/median note
steps: Choose a grouping question in Cross with (or — for none)
Type a keyword in Search question to narrow the cards
Toggle Hide open-ended to include or exclude text questions
Switch the section tab to see another form group
Hover a bar segment or box for its counts or quartiles
serves_tasks: See the answer distribution for every question, section by section of the form
Cross-tabulate one question against another to spot patterns
Repeat the cross-tab for another set of questions, including free-text ones
Compare a numeric rating across groups

features.name: Collection-site map with points/heatmap toggle
features.general: Plot geolocated records on a web map, switch between individual markers (with a popup of key attributes) and a density heatmap, report how many records lack coordinates, and refit the map to the current subset
features.specific: Overview 'Survey locations' Leaflet map with a Points / Heatmap radio, marker popups (e.g. Bairro, Idade), zoom buttons, and the note '2 responses without coordinates are not shown on the map'
steps: Choose Points or Heatmap
Click a marker to read its popup
Zoom or pan the map
Apply a filter and see the map refit to the remaining sites
serves_tasks: See where survey responses were collected on a map and inspect one site
Filter by a demographic or location attribute and see the summary, map and charts update

features.name: Collection progress summary (KPI tiles + time series + per-collector bars)
features.general: Summarise data collection with headline counts (records, collectors, latest entry, % geolocated), a submissions-over-time bar chart whose bin size adapts to the span (weekly or daily), and a per-collector bar chart
features.specific: Overview tiles Responses / Collectors / Latest entry / With location, 'Submissions over time' (entries per week or per day), and 'Responses by collector'
steps: Open Overview and read the four tiles
Hover a time bar for its period and count
Narrow with filters and watch the tiles, bins and collector bars update
serves_tasks: See how many responses came in, from how many collectors, how recently, and how many have coordinates
See how submissions trended over time and who collected them

features.name: Form-schema browser with search
features.general: List every field of a data-collection form with its alias, label, type, storage column, group and stable reference id, and search it to find the identifier needed for a config file
features.specific: Data page 'Form fields' expander: table of alias / question / type / column / group / ref, with the table search (match count, next/previous arrows)
steps: Expand Form fields
Scroll to see full ref ids
Open the table search and type a keyword
Read the highlighted match and its ref (stepping on to later matches was not captured)
serves_tasks: Find a question's stable identifier in the form schema

features.name: Filtered data table with CSV/Excel export
features.general: Show the current subset of records as a sortable table with column hiding, and export exactly that subset as CSV or Excel
features.specific: Data page: 'N responses · 50 columns' table (header sort, Show/hide columns), plus Download CSV and Download Excel buttons (project.csv / project.xlsx)
steps: Apply sidebar filters
Sort by clicking a column header
Hide columns via Show/hide columns
Press Download CSV (verified: exactly the filtered rows, all 50 columns) or Download Excel (only its 8 KB file size was checked; contents not opened)
serves_tasks: Browse the response table, sorting and hiding columns
Export the filtered table for further analysis

features.name: Configured highlight charts
features.general: Show a preset dashboard of charts declared in a config file, either single questions or question × question cross-tabs, all following the global filters
features.specific: Highlights page with 4 configured charts (collection frequency × Bairro, waste destination, service rating × Renda, recycling × Nível de escolaridade)
steps: Open Highlights
Hover a bar segment for its % and count
Apply a filter and re-read the charts
serves_tasks: Browse a preset set of key charts

features.name: Custom indicator page (headline % + breakdown)
features.general: Show a project-specific indicator page with a headline percentage tile and a breakdown chart by group, recomputed for the current filtered subset
features.specific: Recycling page: 'Separate waste for recycling' % tile (28% for all data, 25% with the 15–31/12/2024 date filter) and 'Separation by neighborhood' 100% stacked bars
steps: Open Recycling
Read the headline % tile and the breakdown bars
Apply a filter and re-read the headline %
